mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( user_id, profile_image, type, name, breed, gender, memo, birthdate, neutered, createdAt, updatedAt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{profileImage}, #{type}, #{name}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{memo}, #{birthdate}, #{neutered}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, profile_image, type, name, breed, gender, memo, birthdate, neutered, createdAt, updatedAt FROM pet WHERE id = #{petId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET profile_image = #{profileImage}, type = #{type}, name = #{name}, breed = #{breed}, gender = #{gender}, memo = #{memo}, birthdate = #{birthdate}, neutered = #{neutered}, updatedAt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
